summary: K Wave Media Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a strategic transformation, including disposition of its subsidiary Play Co., Ltd. to eliminate ~$48M in debt, and an amendment with Anson Funds allowing up to $485M in capital from share sales to fund an AI infrastructure pivot. The board approved these moves, subject to shareholder approval at a July 2026 meeting. The mechanics involve a securities purchase agreement providing equity financing for cash. The legacy business sale and debt reduction are expected to de-leverage the balance sheet. Watch for shareholder vote on the disposition and AI platform execution.
